title: AuritusBackend uses GpuRenderFleet instead of its hand-written Batch resources
description: The no-duplication step. BackendStack consumes the PyPI build of the construct for its compute environment, queue and job definition. Review the cdk diff for replacements, and deploy only with the user's OK.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Superseded by the combined plan (epic babulus-d22d6854). The cloud fallback is rebuilt on the construct in M4, with CPU and GPU compute environments, so this one-off swap of the legacy stack is not needed.
